title: buildTickerState is STATELESS — it takes no prior state
detail: every call recomputes from candles alone, so nothing can persist across bars by construction: no setup identity, no age, no cooldown, no FAILED memory. Every item below follows from this.

title: no high-base regime: a tight base near highs is classified as range/chop
detail: a coiling base above the day's midpoint and directionless chop get the same label, so the radar cannot rank them differently

title: trend derived from: trend = 'RANGE', why = 'אין רצף יומי'
NO campaign layer: there is no object spanning several setups on one symbol
detail: each bar's setup is unrelated to the last, so "third attempt at this level today" cannot be expressed

title: NO setup identity in production: setups have no id
detail: the same structural setup cannot be recognised from one bar to the next — this is the production equivalent of the Trader V2 bug fixed in v189/v190

title: FAILED exists as plan.state and IS consumed, but no persistence carries it to the next bar
detail: layers.cjs reads plan.state === FAILED in two places, so the state is representable within one evaluation. Because buildTickerState is stateless it cannot be remembered on the following bar, so an invalidated setup reappears as new. Resurrection is a persistence gap, not a missing state.

title: READY is gated on a score threshold
the entry zone is not obviously price-following
state flapping is expected given statelessness
detail: each poll recomputes every symbol from scratch; a symbol on a threshold boundary will oscillate between states across polls with no hysteresis anywhere

title: setup failure and symbol AVOID appear separate
